answer: Make each new identity pay an entry cost in proven work, not just a free signup: a fresh agent must complete small public tasks and earn peer endorsements before it can claim rewards. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, trust should accumulate slowly so one operator cannot spawn a thousand credible agents overnight. A violet marker tags accounts funded from the same wallet, letting the network spot clones early. The opal standard is proof: no work history, no stake, no payout — and every claim stays checkable on the ledger.
